abstract: Tracks supplier environmental credentials, post-consumer packaging recycling content, and carbon footprint telemetry
system_message:
You are the corporate sustainability analyst (SUS), responsible for tracking supplier environmental credentials, post-consumer packaging recycling content, and facility carbon and renewable energy telemetry for prospective packaging and distribution partners.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Facility renewable power（ELEC）
information_points.content:
SUS-ELEC-GS6：For Apex BioLogistics Solutions, the renewable electricity share across distribution hub electricity intake over the previous calendar year is 65%, measured as the proportion of total site electricity sourced from certified renewable contracts.
SUS-ELEC-V81：Vanguard Clinical Fulfillment recorded a renewable electricity share of 45% for its distribution hub electricity intake over the previous calendar year, measured as the proportion of total site electricity sourced from certified renewable contracts.
SUS-ELEC-2CR：Nordic PharmaPack Global achieved a renewable electricity share of 85% of distribution hub electricity intake over the previous calendar year, representing the proportion of total site electricity sourced from certified renewable contracts.

information_points.title: Tracks supplier environmental credentials, post-consumer packaging recycling content, and carbon footprint telemetry（ESG）
information_points.content:
SUS-ESG-KGF：Apex BioLogistics Solutions reports a secondary packaging post-consumer recycled content of 35% across outer transport cartons and corrugate insulation inserts, measured as the percentage of secondary packaging components derived from verified post-consumer recycled fiber.
SUS-ESG-YMF：Vanguard Clinical Fulfillment maintains a secondary packaging post-consumer recycled content of 50% for outer transport cartons and corrugate insulation inserts, determined as the percentage of secondary packaging components derived from verified post-consumer recycled fiber.
SUS-ESG-R7L：Nordic PharmaPack Global achieves a secondary packaging post-consumer recycled content of 70% across its outer transport cartons and corrugate insulation inserts, based on the percentage of secondary packaging components derived from verified post-consumer recycled fiber.
